$comment: Real EDF and BDF files from public sources, used to check edfcore against bytes that
real software and real hardware produced rather than against its own test writer.
Nothing here is committed. `npm run corpus:fetch` downloads into tests/corpus/files/,
which is gitignored, and verifies every file against the hash below. The corpus tests
skip when the files are absent, so a plain `git clone && npm test` stays offline.
identifiable patient recording and the site attaches no licence to it. The generator
files below are synthetic output from the same author's test-signal generator.

files.name: test_generator.edf
files.licence: No licence stated. Synthetic generator output, not patient data. Downloaded on demand and never redistributed.
files.purpose: Plain EDF. 16 signals at four different sample rates (25/50/100/200 Hz), several physical dimensions (uV, mV, V, %, BPM, DegC), and constant DC channels.

files.name: test_generator_2.edf
files.licence: No licence stated. Synthetic generator output, not patient data.
files.purpose: EDF+C with annotations. Channels are LABELLED WITH THEIR OWN EXPECTED CONTENT ('sine 8.5 Hz', 'squarewave', 'ramp'), which is what makes numeric verification possible rather than just checking it parses.

files.name: test_generator_2.bdf
files.licence: No licence stated. Synthetic generator output, not patient data.
files.purpose: BDF+C, 24-bit samples. Same signals as the EDF+ file above, so the 3-byte sign-extension path can be checked against the 2-byte one on identical content.

files.name: SC4001EC-Hypnogram.edf
files.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By). De-identified.
files.purpose: A real EDF+ scoring file with recordDuration = 0 and no ordinary signals — legal, and the case that breaks readers which divide by the record duration. 154 sleep-stage annotations.

files.name: SC4001E0-PSG.edf
files.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By). De-identified.
files.purpose: A real 22-hour polysomnography recording, 48 MB, 7 signals mixing 100 Hz and 1 Hz, 30-second data records. The random-access claim is measured against this file. Includes a rectal temperature channel in degrees Celsius, whose physical values are independently checkable against human body temperature.

files.name: chb01_01.edf
files.source: PhysioNet CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database v1.0.0 (chb01)
files.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0. De-identified pediatric scalp EEG. Downloaded on demand and never redistributed; see tests/README.md.
files.purpose: A second real clinical recording from a different institution, instrument and decade to sleep-edfx: 23 EEG channels at 256 Hz in one-second records, where sleep-edfx is 7 channels at mixed rates in 30-second records. Named in the README as an open gap since 0.1.

files.name: calib.rec
files.source: edfplus.info calibration files, by Bob Kemp (author of the EDF format)
files.licence: No licence stated. A synthetic calibration signal, not patient data. Downloaded on demand and never redistributed; see tests/README.md.
files.purpose: A conformance file from the format's own author, written to check that a reader gets amplitude AND POLARITY right. Its gain is exactly 200/8192, a power of two, so every physical value is exact in float64 and the expected numbers are round: digital -2048 is exactly -50 uV. The expectations therefore come from the file's design rather than from another library.
